name: Groundswell Studio Programs (free after-school art and social justice)
what_you_do: Make art about social justice in a Brooklyn studio after school. Classes cover mixed media and printmaking. You also paint a community mural. Workshops are about college and jobs in the arts.
who_can_apply: Youth from across New York City. Most classes are ages 14 to 19; the Advanced Portfolio class is ages 16 to 24. You do not need to be an artist.
pay_detail: Free. No pay is mentioned for the studio classes.
duration: The 2025-26 session ran Oct 27 to Mar 12, with one class a week (afternoons, about 2 to 2.5 hours).
deadline_text: Last year (2025-26) open enrollment ended Nov 3, 2025, taken on a rolling basis. The 2026-27 dates were not posted on the page we read.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the Studio Programs page. Questions: Phoebe@groundswell.nyc or Brandon@groundswell.nyc (shown on the page), or call 718-254-9782.
notes: The page we read described the 2025-26 school year, so check the page for the 2026-27 session. Classes are at the Gowanus studio, in person.
